modes.source: an in-tree or checked-out plugin directory: the manifest is verified and every symlink must resolve inside the root; nothing else in the tree is judged, so a source tree with node_modules or tests passes and a spawn plugin whose binary is not yet staged passes
modes.package: an extracted package: every file must belong to a class the kind allows, forbidden globs refuse, ignored files warn, limits apply, required files must exist and the spawn binary must be present and executable

kindInference.note: FALLBACK ONLY. The manifest's own kind field is authoritative and the verifier prefers it whenever it is set; these rules run only for a manifest written before the field existed, and stop at the first match. They stay until the v1 window closes, because a package's rules must not depend on which files happen to be in it.

images.note: Store listing; served at /p/<id>/images/. NOT the nav[].icon and ui[].icon tokens, which the shell resolves from its own icon set and which are never files

binary.note: ${binary} is the basename of the manifest's binary and is present only when spawn is true; bin/** carries helpers in any language

ui.note: built output; the host serves it from the extracted tree at /p/<id>/ui/, and compiled-in plugins keep go:embed behind the same route shape

resources.note: served at /p/<id>/<mount>/; downloads/ with an attachment disposition

data.note: JSON catalogs the plugin reads; the host never interprets them

scripts.note: installed into <HOME>/bin only with operator consent; never put on PATH silently

services.note: unit and sysusers templates the host renders and installs with consent; never auto-enabled

forbidden.match: any depth: a glob is tried against the path and against every suffix of its segments

ignored.note: superseded by the attestation and the extraction digest; warned as BDP5002

refs.binary: the value is a file at the package root, checked when spawn is true: it must exist (BDP4001) and be executable (BDP4002; not judged on Windows)
refs.route: the value is a path the plugin serves; recorded for tooling, not checked against the tree
refs.file: the value is a package-relative file the package ships (identity.readme, identity.images.*, helpers[], scripts[], services[]); recorded for tooling, not checked against the tree — a source tree legitimately names files the package build stages later

host.note: where a host keeps plugin trees, relative to its home; unified across products by the .bdx lifecycle
